evidence.snippet: We introduce SDABench, a benchmark that reorganizes evaluation around six capabilities (descriptive, exploratory, inferential, predictive, causal, and mechanistic) across five domains (Biology, Chemistry, Environment, Geography, Physics).

claire_radar.motivation: Existing benchmarks for scientific data analysis evaluate LLMs primarily on code execution or workflow completion, overlooking that scientific analysis serves to support distinct types of scientific claims: hypothesis exploration, statistical inference, mechanistic explanation, each with different assumptions and validity criteria.

claire_radar.paperTitle: Are LLMs Ready for Scientific Discovery? A Capability-Oriented Benchmark for AI Scientists

source.title: Are LLMs Ready for Scientific Discovery? A Capability-Oriented Benchmark for AI Scientists

claire_radar.whyItMatters: This benchmark reveals that LLMs degrade sharply on tasks requiring assumption selection, latent-process modeling, and mechanistic reasoning, highlighting gaps for scientific discovery applications.
